item.title: Ring Battery Doorbell 2K and 6 more new deals
item.description:
7 new deals this morning, each one checked by hand.

Ring Battery Doorbell 2K (2026) at Best Buy
Ring’s current battery doorbell, with 2K video and two-way talk, is a Best Buy Black Friday Deal at $39.99. No wiring needed, so it suits renters. Recorded clips need a paid Ring plan.

Garmin Forerunner 265 GPS Smartwatch at Best Buy
Garmin’s bright-screened running watch is a Best Buy Black Friday Deal at $299.99, $150 under its usual price. It’s a 2023 model, but still one of the easiest picks for anyone training for a race.

Nespresso Vertuo Pop Coffee and Espresso Maker by De’Longhi at Walmart
Nespresso’s smallest Vertuo machine makes both coffee and espresso from pods, and Walmart has it as a Black Friday Deal at $59 in black, with a 12-capsule starter set. Other colors cost more.

tonies Bluey Toniebox 2 Starter Set at Walmart
A soft, screen-free speaker that plays stories and songs when a child sets a figure on top. Walmart has the Bluey starter set as a Rollback at $99.97, a third off. Extra figures are sold separately.

LEGO Classic Large Creative Brick Box (10698) at Walmart
The big yellow tub: 790 bricks in 33 colors with no instructions to follow, just building. Walmart sells it itself at $33.49, down from $59.99. It’s the safe gift for a kid whose tastes you don’t know.

Owala FreeSip Stainless Steel Water Bottle, 24 oz at Walmart
The bottle you can sip through a straw or tip back and gulp, and a long-time NBC Select favorite. Owala’s own store on Walmart has the Out of the Blue color as a Black Friday Deal at $23.99. Prices differ by color.

Medicube Zero Pore Pads 2.0 at Amazon
Korean exfoliating toner pads with a textured side to buff and a soft side to smooth. NBC Select calls this Amazon’s best price on them this year, and Tom’s Guide lists the deal today too. They contain acids, so go slowly on sensitive skin.
